title: StatCite results
description: One row per query item, in the order submitted. Successful rows carry the cited value under `result` (the same shape statcite.com/v1 and the MCP tools return); failed rows carry an `error` message instead. Successes and failures share the same dataset — failed items are never charged.

results.title: Query results
results.description: Every item from this run: `ok`, `operation`, plus `result` (with citation) or `error`.
